sources.review: Current primary reference documents raw prompt mode, nonstreaming responses, runtime options and response token/duration counters. It describes prompt_eval_count as input tokens and a separate cached prompt counter. That current schema does not certify the installed older server implementation or any training tokenizer/template.

Current primary parameter reference defines num_predict as a maximum output-token setting and num_ctx as inference context capacity. This campaign will send per-request runtime options only, not create/change a Modelfile or model.
